home.headline: From watching... to taking on real roles
home.sub: A youth team focused on empowering Egyptian youth through practical learning that simulates real work environments and helps them build skills closer to the job market.

sections.sectorsDesc: Each sector has a clear role and defined responsibilities, creating a more organized and practical team experience.
sections.programsDesc: Practical programs designed to help young people learn by doing, with organized content that can be presented clearly on the website.
sections.eventsDesc: Online and offline events appear here in an organized way once they are added through the admin dashboard.
sections.youtubeDesc: We are building practical and training-focused content, and program-related videos will be displayed directly on the website in a structured way.
sections.quickContactDesc: For inquiries, partnerships, or collaboration opportunities, send us a message and we will get back to you as soon as possible.
